details: Bitcoin ETFs recorded $265 million in outflows over the past 24 hours, indicating a bearish trend for the leading cryptocurrency. While Ethereum has seen some positive flows, experts suggest these are concentrated in specific funds like BlackRock's ETHA, rather than a broad market rotation, raising questions about a sustained "Ethereum rescue" narrative. This trend highlights a cautious shift in investor sentiment regarding Bitcoin's immediate prospects and a more nuanced view of Ethereum's recent performance.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Face Major Outflows as Ethereum's Rise Questioned

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has postponed its decision on approving Nasdaq Bitcoin options. This regulatory hold comes despite granting a review for CME, indicating continued caution and delays in expanding regulated crypto derivatives offerings in certain venues.
title: SEC Delays Decision on Nasdaq Bitcoin Options

details: After a five-week hiatus, MicroStrategy's Executive Chairman Michael Saylor has signaled a potential resumption of Bitcoin accumulation by the company, stating that a "Bitcoin Drive is engaged" while the company's STRC rate remains at 12%. This suggests renewed institutional confidence and potential buying pressure for Bitcoin.
title: Michael Saylor Hints at Renewed MicroStrategy Bitcoin Purchases

details: Trump Media has clarified that a recent transfer of $165 million worth of Bitcoin to Crypto.com was not a sale. This statement aims to address market speculation regarding the company's crypto holdings and their impact on market dynamics.
title: Trump Media Clarifies $165M Bitcoin Transfer was Not a Sale

details: Hyperliquid, a decentralized exchange, has seen its weekly trading volume for Real World Assets (RWA) exceed that of traditional crypto assets for the first time, now accounting for 54% of its total trading volume. This milestone signals increasing adoption and interest in tokenized real-world assets within the DeFi ecosystem.
title: Hyperliquid's RWA Trading Volume Surpasses Crypto Assets

details: Hong Kong police have issued a warning regarding a romance scam that defrauded a victim of $3.3 million through a fake cryptocurrency application. This incident underscores the ongoing risks of fraud and the importance of vigilance in the crypto space.
title: Hong Kong Police Alert Public to $3.3 Million Crypto Romance Scam

details: Zcash (ZEC) saw its price rise by 3.83 points following announcements of new payment integrations for eSIMs, real estate, and flights. This development, coupled with a bullish technical setup, is driving positive momentum for the privacy-focused cryptocurrency.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Price Jumps on New Payment Integrations

details: Injective (INJ) experienced a 3-4% surge in price, attributed to the launch of institutional validators by Bitwise, ongoing Real World Asset (RWA) pilot programs with companies like POSCO and LG CNS, and significant interoperability upgrades. These developments highlight growing institutional interest and utility for the Injective protocol.
title: Injective (INJ) Surges on Institutional Validators and RWA Pilots

details: Terra Classic (LUNC) rose by 3.45% following a significant burn of 280 million LUNC tokens by Binance and ongoing discussions around a governance proposal to increase the burn tax to 1.5%. These actions aim to reduce LUNC supply and potentially boost its value.
title: Terra Classic (LUNC) Sees Gains Amid Burn and Tax Discussions

details: The STONKBROKER token, a project encompassing DeFi, NFTs, and Real World Assets, surged over 22% in the last 24 hours on the Robinhood Chain, pushing its market capitalization to $43.04 million.
title: STONKBROKER Token Skyrockets Over 22% on Robinhood Chain
